event: Nala sets herself the Fibonacci exercise: modulo by n+2 down, every starting pair, every loop.
prose: You set yourself an exercise: Fibonacci sequences taken modulo n+2, then n+1, then on down, every starting pair carried round to its loop and to the length of that loop.

event: She works one modulus whole: every starting pair, every loop reachable, each loop's length.
prose: You start with n+2 and work it whole. Take a pair of numbers, add them, keep the remainder, carry the pair along, then the next, until a pair comes back that you have already had. That is a loop, and you learn it by its length. Then the next pair, until every pair under n+2 is held in memory with its loop.

event: Window: Path of Basic Numeracy - Tier 3. Mental +1.
She recites every result from the moduli before, then steps down to the next one.
She keeps at it: run the pair, follow it round, name the loop, hold the length.
Her reckoning slows and blurs, and she sleeps.
She wakes in the dark at half past three, and goes back to her tables.
The moduli come easier now; the loops fall into their places in her memory.
Window: Path of Basic Numeracy - Tier 4. Mental +1.
She drifts off again at half past four with the moduli still turning over.
Low voices wake her at nine, talking beside her mother, and she catches nothing whole.
The voices go on, unhurried, and now and then one of them laughs.
